messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: no windows newlines, please
parts:
We're finding Windows newlines in some of the commits and want
to stick to unix-only.

I'll clean it all out before the next release, but please please
please,

* NO TABS IN CODE

* NO WINDOWS NEWLINE

And if you really want to make me nappy,

* NO SPACE BETWEEN FUNCTION NAME AND LEFT PAREN

* SPACE BETWEEN if and LEFT BRACKET

- Bob

messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] no windows newlines, please
parts:
So, after installing cpplint, here's the summary output I get from the summary source tree:
> time cpplint.py --counting=detailed --root=src --extension=hpp $(find src/stan -name '*.hpp') 2>&1 | grep -e "Category" -e "Total error"
Category 'runtime/indentation_namespace' errors found: 1503
Category 'readability/casting' errors found: 63
Category 'whitespace/semicolon' errors found: 60
Category 'runtime/references' errors found: 856
Category 'whitespace/operators' errors found: 50
Category 'whitespace/comments' errors found: 514
Category 'build/include_what_you_use' errors found: 130
Category 'whitespace/line_length' errors found: 1130
Category 'legal/copyright' errors found: 800
Category 'build/namespaces' errors found: 4
Category 'build/include' errors found: 36
Category 'whitespace/empty_loop_body' errors found: 1
Category 'whitespace/end_of_line' errors found: 7290
Category 'runtime/int' errors found: 21
Category 'whitespace/comma' errors found: 4404
Category 'readability/namespace' errors found: 1588
Category 'whitespace/indent' errors found: 443
Category 'runtime/explicit' errors found: 205
Category 'whitespace/newline' errors found: 1532
Category 'readability/braces' errors found: 225
Category 'readability/todo' errors found: 6
Category 'build/include_order' errors found: 1100
Category 'whitespace/forcolon' errors found: 3
Category 'build/storage_class' errors found: 3
Category 'whitespace/blank_line' errors found: 841
Category 'whitespace/parens' errors found: 386
Category 'whitespace/braces' errors found: 116
Total errors found: 23310

real    0m37.399s
user    0m35.911s
sys    0m1.177s

It takes under a minute to run, so I think it's well worth it. I think we should filter out these error messages:
- runtime/indentation_namespace: wants there to be no indentation with namespaces. Since some of us use emacs to indent, this isn't the default.
- readability/namespace: wants "// namespace <name>" to end each namespace. We haven't been following this.
- legal/copyright: wants a copyright notice on each file
- whitespace/line_length: is set to 80 characters. Should we make it longer?
- whitespace/indent: wants 'public:' in class definitions to be indented by 1 space. There is a google style emacs file that could help with this sort of indentation. I'm ok without it indented.


Some key problems this will find:
- whitespace/newline: WINDOWS NEWLINES!
- whitespace/parens: "if(", "foo (", "for("


This I can go either way, but can suppress for now:
- runtime/reference: 

src/stan/agrad/autodiff.hpp:198:  Is this a non-const reference? If so, make const or use a pointer: Eigen::Matrix<double,Eigen::Dynamic,Eigen::Dynamic>& H  [runtime/references] [2]

the function signature looks like:
    template <typename F>
    void
    hessian(const F& f,
            const Eigen::Matrix<double,Eigen::Dynamic,1>& x,
            double& fx,
            Eigen::Matrix<double,Eigen::Dynamic,1>& grad,
            Eigen::Matrix<double,Eigen::Dynamic,Eigen::Dynamic>& H) {

and it wants grad and H to be pointers.  (see http://google-styleguide.googlecode.com/svn/trunk/cppguide.html#Reference_Arguments)


For the time being, I'm going to set up a project that runs through the source code and we can see if the Jenkins output is useful.




Daniel

messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] no windows newlines, please
parts:
Ok, got something working. http://d1m1s1b1.stat.columbia.edu:8080/job/Stan%20-%20CppLint/

That'll show you a chart of warnings between builds. We've got ~18k right now. To get detailed information, click on the "CppLint Warnings" link on the left: http://d1m1s1b1.stat.columbia.edu:8080/job/Stan%20-%20CppLint/warnings9

You can click through and get the individual warning messages. I didn't include the test files.


Questions:
1. is this useful?
2. should we run this on every pull request?
3. should we use different settings?
4. should we run this on the test code? without autogenerated tests, this pushes the number to ~80k and makes Jenkins unbearably slow. if we were to go through this, my suggestion would be to get the numbers lower first, then start running it on the test when it's under 20k total.



Daniel

messages.author: a5e83218c834e013
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] no windows newlines, please
parts: - readability/namespace: wants "// namespace <name>" to end each namespace. We haven't been following this.
I like requiring this (we have some long files), but I’m not wedded to it.
- whitespace/line_length: is set to 80 characters. Should we make it longer?
I’d say no more than 100.
- whitespace/indent: wants 'public:' in class definitions to be indented by 1 space. There is a google style emacs file that could help with this sort of indentation. I'm ok without it indented.
Mixing 1 and 2 space indents makes me sad.  :-(

src/stan/agrad/autodiff.hpp:198:  Is this a non-const reference? If so, make const or use a pointer: Eigen::Matrix<double,Eigen::Dynamic,Eigen::Dynamic>& H  [runtime/references] [2]

the function signature looks like:
    template <typename F>
    void
    hessian(const F& f,
            const Eigen::Matrix<double,Eigen::Dynamic,1>& x,
            double& fx,
            Eigen::Matrix<double,Eigen::Dynamic,1>& grad,
            Eigen::Matrix<double,Eigen::Dynamic,Eigen::Dynamic>& H) {

and it wants grad and H to be pointers.  (see http://google-styleguide.googlecode.com/svn/trunk/cppguide.html#Reference_Arguments)
But that changes the whole interface!  What a wacky error.
